headline: 新片《The Dink》上映
context: 演員 Jake Johnson 主演新片《The Dink》，這是一部以匹克球（pickleball）為題材的運動喜劇，他形容這部片像是「更性感版的《Challengers》」。Jake Johnson 受訪時說，自己原本對匹克球一竅不通，是為了這個角色苦練了好幾個月。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: As Nick in the blockbuster TV comedy, the actor was adored by millions. So will his new comedy The Dink, which he jokes is a ‘sexier Challengers’, make him even more popular? You might assume that Jake Johnson would know a little something about pickleball. The actor is starring in The Dink, a sort of spiritual heir to Dodgeball – it has a Ben Stiller cameo – and he plays Dusty Boyd, a former tennis pro turned plucky pickleball upstart. Presumably Johnson took the gig because he has a deep love of the sport, a fondness for its pockmarked balls and weirdly smooth paddles? “No experience of it whatsoever,” says the actor, cheerfully, on a video call from Los Angeles. Yet this underdog of a racket sport, loved by retirees, found him anyway. At the climax of the movie, Dusty must play against an old foe, which meant Johnson had to undertake months of real-life training in pickleball and tennis, so it looked as if he could play. “It was like WWE. They call it fake wrestling. The outcome is there, but you still have to wrestle. That was probably the most stressful part of the film to me.” Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Johnson is delusional ex-tennis player The Hammer, who has to switch to the sport he loathes after injury There’s some funny stuff here in this engagingly silly sports comedy from producer-star Jake Johnson about the world of pickleball, and how this (allegedly) facile pseudo-tennis game for children and old people threatens to infantilise and dumb down the world of tennis itself. Dusty (Johnson) is a middle-aged loser, delusionally nicknamed The Hammer, who once showed early promise at tennis before getting crushed by a humiliating teen encounter with the young Andy Roddick (playing himself in cameo). These days Dusty coaches at the tennis club owned by his dad (Ed Harris), who is scowlingly contemptuous of everything Dusty says and does. Only one thing allows poor Dusty to reclaim his self-respect as a man and a tennis player: his utter loathing for pickleball, whose followers are grudgingly permitted one of their toytown mini-courts at the club – and he duly gets a meet-cute quarrel with pickleball enthusiast Candace (Mary Steenburgen). threads_text:
新片《The Dink》上映

演員 Jake Johnson 主演新片《The Dink》，是一部以匹克球（pickleball）為題材的運動喜劇，設定上像是《Dodgeball》的精神續作。他在片中飾演一位曾是網球選手、如今轉戰匹克球界的角色。受訪時 Jake Johnson 坦言，自己原本對這項運動一竅不通，是為了這個角色才苦練了好幾個月的匹克球與網球，片尾那場關鍵對決，他形容練習過程「像 WWE 摔角一樣，結果早就定好，但你還是得真的打一場」。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 21 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 有部新的運動喜劇要上片了，主角是匹克球（pickleball）。Jake Johnson 在片中演一位曾經打網球、後來轉戰匹克球的選手，他自己受訪時說，原本對這項運動完全不懂，是為了演這個角色才苦練了好幾個月。片尾那場關鍵對決，他形容練習起來就像摔角比賽，結果早就定好，但還是得真槍實彈打一場。
